description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Cisco is hiring a Software Engineer to develop secure, well-tested software that emphasizes simplicity and user experience. The role includes collaborating with design and product teams, documenting solutions, testing and debugging software, and contributing to features from technical design through completion.
Software Engineer developing customer-facing front- and back-end features, testing CI/CD pipelines, and debugging production defects

Responsibilities:
• Develop clean, functional, and well-tested code across front-end or back-end software components to deliver customer-facing features on schedule
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including design and product management, to build intuitive user experiences aligned with Cisco Design Thinking Principles
• Author clear technical design specifications and contribute to user documentation to ensure maintainability and seamless adoption
• Execute automated unit, integration, and reliability tests within continuous integration (CI/CD) pipelines to maintain high software quality and prevent regressions
• Debug and triage software defects in development and production environments to ensure high system uptime and rapid incident resolution
• Apply secure coding standards and participate actively in peer code reviews to maintain robust security and privacy compliance

Requirements:
• Demonstrated hands-on software development experience gained through professional work, technical internships, academic coursework, or engineering projects
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field or 2+ years of related professional experience, OR a Master's degree in a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical work experience)
• Practical experience writing, debugging, and testing code in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, C++, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript)

Preferred:
• Experience assisting in peer code reviews and executing tests for scale, reliability, and velocity within own code
• Experience monitoring and triaging incident reports, participating in postmortems, and supporting potential on-call duties
• Demonstrated ability to analyze information, solve straightforward operational or technical problems, and eliminate blockers to meet deadlines
• Strong collaboration and communication skills to partner effectively across engineering, design, and product management teams
• Exposure to current technologies, tools, and modern frameworks through coursework, projects, or internships
